decisions.reason: The Black Edition range is a design line that has grown from a mention to its own page, fits the black bathroom trend and extends existing drains at low incremental cost.
CeraFrame Liquid serves the growing market for seamless, joint-free bathrooms and has kept its own page across both years, signalling a stable place in the shower channel portfolio.
The pump-drain shower channel launched in 2024 likely replaces the dropped pump solution C, so it is a fresh successor product the firm will give time to establish in renovation markets.
